description: The sender's output contract. An Intelligent Block has a fixed machine spine and adaptive flesh: the schema is rigid so machines can render it, the composition is intelligent so humans love it. Only essence is mandatory. Every view and every layer must earn its place — a missing view is a decision, not a gap. Sparse beats complete.

as_of.description: Freshness, visible. Stale blocks say so; they never pretend to be live.

essence.description: MANDATORY. One line. If it takes two lines, the block is not understood yet.

id.description: Stable block identity. Smart Notes keep SN-NNNN; new blocks use IB-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN.

kind.description: What the block IS. The composer reads kind + audience to choose views, layers, and order. Guidelines, never a template.

layers.description: Earned layers. Each must pass the test: does this change what the reader UNDERSTANDS or DOES? If not, cut it. Order by intake speed — the first screen delivers 80% of the value.

execution_prompt.description: Copy-paste prompt the reader can fire. Present ONLY when there is something to fire. Briefings and proposals get one; a poem doesn't. Never manufacture an action.

proof.description: Smart links. Ten-star service: show, don't tell. Every verifiable claim rides with its evidence.

source.description: Canonical provenance path back into the brain, e.g. BRAIN/05-MEMORY/SMART-NOTES/2026/10/15/.../SN-0807/

subtitle.description: Optional one-line expansion of the title. 18px energy.

topics.description: Routing tags — which Hub room(s) this block belongs in.

truth_state.description: Governance state, made visible. CANDIDATE = proposed, not proven.

views.description: The five-view palette. Include ONLY views that earn their place. Never fill all five by default; never render a forced view (a child view on a database migration is noise). The reader may switch between whichever views are present — the lens switcher.

child.description: A bright 10-year-old gets it. Concrete, vivid, short.

grandma.description: Patient, respectful, zero assumed context. Why should she care?

human.description: Plain words for the person. Warm, direct, no jargon.

machine.description: Structured, parseable: fields, values, refs. For systems.

naya.description: For another Naya: exact values, procedures, constraints, what to do.

title: NayaPOWER Intelligent Block V1
